Note:

The Company has raised funds aggregating to INR 1,813.03 Lakhs through the issuance of 1,20,06,831 share warrants. As per the terms of the issue, 25% of the issue price, amounting to INR 453.26 Lakhs (INR 3.775 per warrant), was received as upfront subscription money on April 09, 2025.

The said amount of INR 453.26 Lakhs was fully utilized during the quarter ended June 30, 2025.

During the June quarter, the Company has received the balance 75% of the issue price amounting to INR 543.91 Lakhs (INR 11.325 per warrant) from 2 (Two) warrant holders i.e. Dream Realmart Private Limited and Niranjana Properties Private Limited pursuant to exercise of warrants into equity shares.

During the current quarter under review, the Company has received the balance 75% of the issue price amounting to INR 815.86 Lakhs (INR 11.325 per warrant) from remaining 4 (Four) warrant holders i.e. Aditya Baid, Dalima Baid, Asmita Baid and Alpana Baid pursuant to exercise of warrants into equity shares.

Pursuant to the aforesaid conversion and allotment, all the outstanding warrants allotted pursuant to the preferential issue have now been fully converted into equity shares. Accordingly, no warrants remain outstanding for conversion.

The amount disclosed under “funds utilized” pertains to the quarter ended June 30, 2025, March 31, 2026 and September 30, 2026.
